mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% relative to historical averages reduces the risk-free rate component in equity valuation models, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 200 and FEDFUNDS above 4.0% indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and equity risk premiums, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts below 2000 thousand units signal weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, preceding negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST falls below 2000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 125 index points indicates robust manufacturing output and economic momentum, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 125.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 100,000 in one month signals imminent recessionary conditions that trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS falls > 100,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Weak retail sales (RSAFS < 350,000 million) combined with elevated FEDFUNDS (> 3.5%) indicates constrained consumer spending and restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 350000 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 3.0% quarterly indicates strong economic momentum that boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth > 3.0%.
